verdict.rationale: Deepgram's official dg CLI ships a built-in MCP server that exposes Deepgram APIs to AI coding/agent tools, documented at a dedicated agentic-tools/mcp-server page and confirmed by a live probe. This is a first-party, officially supported MCP server enabling agent connection, though it's CLI-bundled rather than a standalone hosted MCP endpoint and lacks independent/hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: independent/community verification of the MCP server working end-to-end, and details on hosted (non-CLI) MCP endpoint options.
